"If you look for the light, you can often find it. But if you look for the dark that is all you will ever see."

I wonder, why did we choose darkness as the negative of the two? Why is light considered good, holy, divine, etc.. While darkness is considered evil, unholy, corrupt? I mean the universe in its creation was consumed in darkness for a long time before light even existed. Can there not just be light and dark without connotations of good or bad? can there be bad light and good dark?

Great quote by the way. Iroh is a favorite of mine in the Avatar universe.

That's really thoughtful, I think that the reason human's chose light as good and dark as bad is because of how unknown the dark is. As tough or curious as history paints humanity to be, humans still prefer not to leave their area of familiarity. You never know what you will run into in the dark and that's scary. Its the mystery more than the darkness itself. My analysis is probably arbitrary as shit, but whatever.

Why is light considered good, holy, divine, etc.. While darkness is considered evil, unholy, corrupt?

I think it's just probably that for most of our evolution and our early cultural development we didn't have any artificial light. In those times - the dark was very dangerous - at least in comparison to the light. We probably developed a sense of fear as a safety mechanism.
